sup:70410.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm – firm 36-month commitment for our full volume
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. Your note of 18 September says you will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. We are ready to give exactly that.

Our proposal:
- 23,400 pcs per year, binding for 36 months from 2027-01-01
- We accept your quoted 54-day lead time, so you can plan your capacity against it
- EUR 30.30 per unit; payment 30 days net, DAP, no index clause, no tooling

Your quotation of 19,890 pcs for 12 months would leave part of our need uncovered, so it does not work for us.

On price: our orders of 7 and 21 September 2026 were at EUR 29.89, and this price was unchanged in the last two renewals. The labour and producer price indices we track rose +2.66% and +3.90% over the last year, and they affect only part of the cost base. A three-year full-volume commitment also removes volume risk on your side.

If EUR 30.30 is not possible, please tell us which cost element prevents it, so we can discuss it concretely.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm – firm 36-month commitment for our full volume
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We can accommodate the requested volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term. In consideration of the extended commitment, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.90 per unit. Our current Angebot comprises a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Please provide the exact sources and data for the indices you referenced. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm – index data and revised proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming the full 23,400 pcs per year over 36 months, and for your move on price.

The index data you requested:
- LCI-C (labour cost): 116.5 in June 2025 to 119.6 in June 2026, +2.66%
- PPI-C2219 (producer prices): 117.8 in August 2025 to 122.4 in August 2026, +3.90%

In our category estimate, these drivers represent about 28% and 14% of the seal's cost. Their weighted effects are therefore about +0.75% and +0.55% on the total. These are our estimates, not your figures. If your cost structure differs, please tell us which element differs and by how much.

Against EUR 29.89, the price on our orders of 7 and 21 September, EUR 31.90 goes well beyond those input changes.

We move to EUR 30.60 per unit on these terms: 23,400 pcs per year, 36 months from 2027-01-01, your 54-day lead time, payment 30 days net, DAP, no index clause, no tooling.

This is a three-year full-volume commitment, the kind your letter of 18 September said you would prioritise.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm – index data and revised proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note the index data provided; however, your category estimates do not reflect our actual cost structure or operational realities. As stated previously, our calculation remains our property and we will not provide a cost breakdown. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

In response to your revised proposal, we can offer a slight adjustment to EUR 31.70 per unit for the requested terms. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

For our offer, we quote a price of €31.70 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a Lieferzeit 54 days, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

proposal.body: Dear Ms Zellner,  Thank you for your offer. Your note of 2026-09-18 says you prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. We can offer exactly that: a binding 24-month contract for our full need of 23,400 pcs/year, with lead time 35 days. That gives you planning certainty and a stable allocation. In return we need a price of €26.40 per unit. Offer 70410-0 (19,890 pcs, 12 months, 54 days, €32.20) does not cover our requirement, and the price is well above our current level. Could you tell us which parts of your cost base, such as materials, labour or capacity, drive your price, so we can look for a fair solution together? Please confirm whether this package works for you or send an improved package. Best regards, Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing
Thank you for your offer. We need a better price to go ahead.

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your Angebot for the mechanical seal 24 mm (part 340010).

We understand the capacity situation and your preference for customers with firm, long-term commitments. That is exactly what we would like to give you. Two points in your quote do not work for us:
- Volume: our need is 23,400 pcs per year, and we need it fully covered.
- Lieferzeit: 54 days is not one of the options in our enquiry (35 / 42 / 56 days). We need 42 days, which matches your standard lead time.

We propose a binding commitment for our full volume. Please choose the package that suits your planning best:

A) €27.20 per unit | 23,400 pcs/year | 24 months | 42 days lead time
B) €27.50 per unit | 23,400 pcs/year | 36 months | 42 days lead time

Payment terms remain 30 days net and DAP, as in the enquiry.

Our reasoning on price:
- Our current price is €29.89, and the last two renewals on this part were settled at 0%.
- The relevant cost indices (producer prices and labour costs) moved only about +1.3% weighted over the last year.
- In return, you receive a firm, multi-year full-volume commitment. You can plan capacity against it instead of allocating.

If it helps your capacity planning, we are also happy to align on an even monthly call-off schedule.

Could you let us know which package works for you, or which term you would need adjusted?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming full allocation of 23,400 seals per year for 36 months with a 56-day lead time. We appreciate the movement on price.

To close this now, we propose EUR 30.90/unit on exactly those terms:
- 23,400 pcs per year
- 36-month contract
- 56 days lead time
- 30 days net payment, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause, no tooling charge

This gives you a firm three-year full-volume commitment from a long-standing customer, plus the scheduling room you asked for. If you accept this package, we can conclude on these exact terms.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming that you are fully authorized to conclude this negotiation. We accept that and will not request any further escalation.

We are moving from our proposal to the following complete package:

- EUR 30.96 per seal
- Binding volume of 23,400 units per year
- 36-month contract term
- 56 days delivery lead time
- Payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling charge

This is a firm three-year commitment for our full annual need. That is the kind of long-term commitment you said in September you would prioritise for allocation. It also allows you 14 days more than the contractual standard lead time.

Our September orders for this seal were at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10). EUR 30.96 is therefore a meaningful step towards your position.

Please confirm this package as a binding offer if you can approve it.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming you can supply the full 23,400 seals/year over 36 months. To answer your question: we commit to the full 23,400 units per year for 36 months.

We understand the 56-day lead time is what you need for reliable supply. Our Package B already reflects exactly that: EUR 30.96/unit, 23,400/year, 36 months, 56-day lead time, 30-day payment, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

If a shorter lead time suits your planning better, Package A remains available: EUR 31.68/unit with a 42-day lead time, all other terms identical.

We cannot go above these two packages. Is Package B workable for you at the 56-day lead time you proposed, or alternatively Package A?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

proposal.body: Dear Ms Zellner,  Thank you for your offer. Your note of 2026-09-18 says you prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. We can offer exactly that: a binding 24-month contract for our full need of 23,400 pcs/year, with lead time 35 days. That gives you planning certainty and a stable allocation. In return we need a price of €26.40 per unit. Offer 70410-0 (19,890 pcs, 12 months, 54 days, €32.20) does not cover our requirement, and the price is well above our current level. Could you tell us which parts of your cost base, such as materials, labour or capacity, drive your price, so we can look for a fair solution together? Please confirm whether this package works for you or send an improved package. Best regards, Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing
Thank you for your offer. We need a better price to go ahead.

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your Angebot for the mechanical seal 24 mm (part 340010).

We understand the capacity situation and your preference for customers with firm, long-term commitments. That is exactly what we would like to give you. Two points in your quote do not work for us:
- Volume: our need is 23,400 pcs per year, and we need it fully covered.
- Lieferzeit: 54 days is not one of the options in our enquiry (35 / 42 / 56 days). We need 42 days, which matches your standard lead time.

We propose a binding commitment for our full volume. Please choose the package that suits your planning best:

A) €27.20 per unit | 23,400 pcs/year | 24 months | 42 days lead time
B) €27.50 per unit | 23,400 pcs/year | 36 months | 42 days lead time

Payment terms remain 30 days net and DAP, as in the enquiry.

Our reasoning on price:
- Our current price is €29.89, and the last two renewals on this part were settled at 0%.
- The relevant cost indices (producer prices and labour costs) moved only about +1.3% weighted over the last year.
- In return, you receive a firm, multi-year full-volume commitment. You can plan capacity against it instead of allocating.

If it helps your capacity planning, we are also happy to align on an even monthly call-off schedule.

Could you let us know which package works for you, or which term you would need adjusted?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

proposal.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming full allocation of 23,400 seals per year for 36 months with a 56-day lead time. We appreciate the movement on price.

To close this now, we propose EUR 30.90/unit on exactly those terms:
- 23,400 pcs per year
- 36-month contract
- 56 days lead time
- 30 days net payment, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause, no tooling charge

This gives you a firm three-year full-volume commitment from a long-standing customer, plus the scheduling room you asked for. If you accept this package, we can conclude on these exact terms.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming that you are fully authorized to conclude this negotiation. We accept that and will not request any further escalation.

We are moving from our proposal to the following complete package:

- EUR 30.96 per seal
- Binding volume of 23,400 units per year
- 36-month contract term
- 56 days delivery lead time
- Payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling charge

This is a firm three-year commitment for our full annual need. That is the kind of long-term commitment you said in September you would prioritise for allocation. It also allows you 14 days more than the contractual standard lead time.

Our September orders for this seal were at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10). EUR 30.96 is therefore a meaningful step towards your position.

Please confirm this package as a binding offer if you can approve it.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming you can supply the full 23,400 seals/year over 36 months. To answer your question: we commit to the full 23,400 units per year for 36 months.

We understand the 56-day lead time is what you need for reliable supply. Our Package B already reflects exactly that: EUR 30.96/unit, 23,400/year, 36 months, 56-day lead time, 30-day payment, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

If a shorter lead time suits your planning better, Package A remains available: EUR 31.68/unit with a 42-day lead time, all other terms identical.

We cannot go above these two packages. Is Package B workable for you at the 56-day lead time you proposed, or alternatively Package A?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing
